integrity: Full logical proof and standalone exact rational Fourier illustrations are supplied. The checker is finite corroboration only; novelty and publication priority are not externally certified.
scientific_limitations: Annealed law for independently selected two distinct integer circle multipliers, centered real BV observables, and one-sided perturbation of a deterministic coboundary; no noninteger or correlated-noise assertion; the proof uses standard martingale CLT, not a formal certification.
title: Distinct integer beta maps eliminate zero variance and give an exact noise-onset coefficient
